name: 休憩記録の内訳
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Edit target Image1 LH11-0008 v001. Change ONLY the two right utility glyphs. ORIGINAL Deputy image2 takes priority for glyph geometry, proportions, optical weight, alignment, spacing and fine control details; Japanese mock image3 is secondary copy guidance and must not override source. Reduce the upper-right expanded UP-chevron to HALF its current width/height, with thin source-like slate stroke, centered at its current center. Reduce right-hand trash glyph to HALF its current width/height at same center, restore its original bin shape: small top handle and lid, slightly tapered filled slate bin body with three tiny WHITE VERTICAL SLOT CUTOUTS. Original source trash is a detailed small glyph, not a large solid empty bucket. Both should be about 10–12logicalpx relative to14px body type. Do not change any text, sizes, wrapping, content, fields, links, alignment, white surfaces, forest-green link color, card geometry or shadows. Keep: 休憩 / 食事休憩 30分 / 種類 / 食事休憩 / 時間 / 30分 / 休憩を追加 / 時刻を設定. Meiryo role typography and white/forest-green/slate system remain locked. No new controls or extra colors. Static raster candidate only.
reviewNotes: v002実画像を原画優先で比較。上シェブロンと削除記号を小さい原画比率へ修正、削除箱の溝を復元。日本語/30分/二リンク/白面/森林緑リンク/展開方向/欄比率保持、切れなし確認。正確な書体寸法/ピクセル一致/実操作は未検証。エージェント画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
